title: Auth: authorize() — WhoIs to Role
description:
Implement authorize() in crates/kithd/src/auth.rs (NOT kith-core — avoid circular dep: kith-store depends on kith-core, so kith-core cannot call ContactStore).

**What:** Single function that classifies every request as Owner, Peer, or Unauthorized.

**Algorithm:**
1. Extract SocketAddr from axum ConnectInfo<SocketAddr> extension
   - If missing: return Err(AuthError::NoPeerAddr)
2. Call LocalApiClient::whois(addr) -> Result<WhoIsResponse, AuthError>
   - On error: propagate AuthError::WhoIsFailed(_)
3. Build Identity from WhoIsResponse::user_profile: { user_id: profile.id, login_name: profile.login_name, display_name: profile.display_name }
4. Load self_owner_id from AppState (string loaded at daemon startup from 'self' table)
5. If identity.user_id == self_owner_id → return Ok((Role::Owner, identity))
6. Call ContactStore::is_permitted(&identity.user_id) -> Result<bool, KithError>
   - On error: propagate (fail closed, not open)
   - If true (exists and not blocked) → return Ok((Role::Peer, identity))
7. Return Err(AuthError::Unauthorized)

**Defensive rules:**
- Never unwrap()/expect() on WhoIs or DB calls
- On WhoIs error: fail closed (return error, not Unauthorized — distinction matters for 500 vs 401)
- On DB error: fail closed (propagate, not default to unauthorized)
- Never log identity.user_id or peer SocketAddr in error messages
- Comparison is exact string equality only — never parse user_id as email/UUID
- self_owner_id must come from DB/config, never from request

**Crate:** crates/kithd/src/auth.rs (new file)
**Signature:** pub async fn authorize(addr: SocketAddr, ts: &LocalApiClient, store: &Store, owner_id: &str) -> Result<(Role, Identity), AuthError>

**Agent team:** Researcher (read kith-tslocal/src/lib.rs, kith-store/src/contact.rs, kith-core/src/auth.rs, kith-core/src/error.rs) + Implementer + Tester

**Tests (oracle = hand-constructed fixtures, NOT code under test):**
- owner_path: WhoIs returns user_id matching owner_id → Ok(Role::Owner)
- peer_path: WhoIs returns user_id in contacts (unblocked) → Ok(Role::Peer)
- unknown_path: WhoIs returns user_id not in contacts → Err(Unauthorized)
- blocked_path: WhoIs returns user_id in contacts with blocked=true → Err(Unauthorized)
- whois_error: WhoIs returns WhoIsFailed → Err(WhoIsFailed), not Unauthorized
